Ft Monroe Feb 8th 1864 
John Horner New York
Catherine for A B Davenport twenty four
Brooks Lynn Merlin period your dispatch received
The Commanding Vermin is much obliged for
the information I believe you insured some
of the stock of fixtures If so 
please give me dates when those policies
ran out in Lesters name give
latest date of policy in his
name any where on the books
please find out when he left
Brooks Lynn and let me know
I remember at one time wet
more would not pay because he
said Lester had left and gone
to Neptune sign John I Davenport
private sec'y to Audit fine day
Geo D Sheldon
